description: Solar Energy Generation (Hawkesbury City Council) is a dataset listed in Hawkesbury City open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Hawkesbury City Council. This dataset contains hourly aggregated data for energy consumption, production, and distribution from multiple photovoltaic (PV) systems. It includes detailed information on energy self-consumption, energy fed into the grid, energy purchased from the grid, and total energy production and consumption. Coverage: Hawkesbury, New South Wales. The portal files it under Environmental Protection. Its keywords are Electricity, Solar, PV, Sustainability & Net Zero dashboard, Sustainability Dashboard. The portal shows 388,094 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-hawkesbury-nsw-gov-au-portal.
